blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Refusing to compromise his independence in his bid for the top judicial post, Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen, during his public interview before the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) underscored that high office must never come at the expense of judicial integrity. “I give no bribe or assurance to anyone about any matter at any time and to anyone. I do not offer a resort that simply follows my own political views, nor do i offer loyalty or protection to anyone,” Leonen said in his opening statement.
